about: Abilities: what a creature can choose to do. Orsino skills and spells are generated into data/catalog/orsino/abilities.json; this file holds Kyr's own abilities and adaptations. kind is technique, spell (with tradition, level and school or domain; a spell spends one slot) or natural. effect is written in the Kyr effect language; effects is the typed form.

cure_minor.name: Cure Minor Wounds
cure_minor.description: Bind a scratch or a bruise: one point.

source.notes: The SRD's Cure Minor Wounds (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 51): a cantrip, one point on one ally, its school the SRD's conjuration beside its domain. Out of a fight it mends each member once between rests, as every healing cantrip (Tended). Omitted: the harm a cure does the undead (the SRD's touch and its Will save for half). Before, Orsino's 1d4.

weakness.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
weakness.description: A ray from your hand saps one foe it strikes: 1d6 off its Strength, and a point more for every two levels you have, to five more, for a minute for every level.

source.notes: The SRD's Ray of Enfeeblement (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 58): first-level arcane necromancy; one foe a ranged touch lands on (Touch), no save, spell resistance answering it, 1d6 off its Strength and a point each two casting levels, to +5 at the tenth (an amount its caster throws: ConditionAmount, the enfeebled condition), a minute a casting level (Lasting). Its first-level place moves it from second-level necromancer picks. Before, Orsino's Weakness: second level; Strength two less and two less harm a blow for three rounds, a Fortitude save against 14 + the caster's level.

flesh_to_stone.name: Flesh to Stone
flesh_to_stone.description: Turn one foe to stone where it stands, unless it holds itself together against it; stone it stays until the fight is over.
flesh_to_stone.effect: Apply petrified to enemy for 1000 turns unless fortitude save against (16 + floor((#castingScore - 10) / 2) + floor(#castingLevel / 2) + #bonusSpellDC).

source.notes: The SRD's Flesh to Stone (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 55): sixth level, transmutation, one creature, a Fortitude save to negate at case 7's difficulty, spell resistance answering it (exact). Converted: its instantaneous, lasting stone is Kyr's petrified for the fight it is laid in (the condition's lifetime ends with the fight; Stone to Flesh ends it sooner). Omitted: the stone kept past the fight, and its gear turned with it. Before, Orsino's ten rounds against 18 + the caster's whole level, no spell resistance.

plane_shift.name: Plane Shift
plane_shift.description: Carry yourself and your company to another plane of existence, to its threshold, where doors from elsewhere arrive.

source.notes: GT-02: the kernel's typed travel effect, cast outside a fight by the act the canon offers (Have {caster} cast Plane Shift to {plane}, data/rules/canon.kyr), to the plane's threshold (thresholdOf, data/imbar); the company is set down there (Campaign.carry). Adapted: no forked rod, and the threshold rather than a place of the caster's choosing within the plane; Imbar has no threshold, so it does not carry a company home. In a fight it ends the fight as an escape (Battle: a travel sets the location).

Orsino offers player-side combatants Flee every turn: an even chance (Math.random() < 0.5; Kyr rolls from the seeded stream) to end the fight. Kyr's company gives ground with each try that fails: three in four the second time, sure the third; and in the first round of a fight that fell on it unwarned, which it saw begin, it acts first and gets away for certain. Orsino's monster Escape skill rolls a will save that, as written for fear effects, makes a successful save fail; Kyr uses the player rule's even chance for every creature on the other side that flees.

fire_ward.name: Fire ward
fire_ward.description: Ward a companion against fire for about two hours.
fire_ward.effect: Apply fireproof to ally for 2 hours.

source.notes: Kyr technique granted by a ward focus; applies fireproof on the world clock for twelve units.

cold_ward.name: Cold ward
cold_ward.description: Ward a companion against cold for about two hours.
cold_ward.effect: Apply waterproof to ally for 2 hours.

source.notes: Kyr technique granted by a ward focus, as the fire ward is (GT-01): applies waterproof on the world clock for twelve units, the ward against the Plane of Water's cold.

despair.name: Despair
despair.description: It turns its face on whoever stands before it, and the sight holds them still with dread: whoever does not master their fear cannot move for a while. Once a day.
despair.effect: Apply paralyzed to enemies for 2 turns unless fear save against 16.

source.notes: The SRD mummy's despair (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 30): whoever sees it saves against fear (the SRD's Will, DC 16, exact) or is paralysed with fear; two rounds for the SRD's 1d4 (converted). Adapted: the SRD's is at sight and takes no action, where Kyr's is the royal mummy's act on its turn, once a day (the SRD's: once a day for whoever saved). Its save is fear's (Remove Fear's heartened answers it), as Cause Fear's is (case 20).

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: A long howl that turns the blood cold: whoever hears it fights afraid for a while.
howl.effect: Apply fear to enemies for 2 turns unless wisdom save against (12).

source.notes: A wolf's howl, whatever wolf (the owner, 6 November: not a winter howl). The bites, rime and rending, and the bronze custodian's sweep and chain are gone: a beast bites with its natural weapon, and a custodian sweeps as a fighter does and strikes with its chain.

breathe_fire.name: Fire breath
breathe_fire.description: Fire pours over everyone before the creature. A quick or hardy creature takes half. The fire takes a while to rekindle; three times a day at most.

source.notes: Area fire damage scales as 2d6 + 2 per creature level, with a breath save for half and a three-turn recharge. Maturity supplies a generated dragon level; its natural bite remains available. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_cold.name: Cold breath
breathe_cold.description: Breath pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_acid.name: Acid breath
breathe_acid.description: Breath pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_lightning.name: Lightning breath
breathe_lightning.description: Breath pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_poison.name: Poison breath
breathe_poison.description: Breath pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves damage. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
magic_missile.description: A dart of force springs from your hand and strikes unerringly, and another for every two levels you have past the first, to five.

source.notes: The SRD's Magic Missile (doc/architecture/mission-21/rules/magic-missile.md): first level, a missile at the first casting level and one more for every two past it, to five at the ninth (by #castingLevel), each 1d4+1 force dealt on its own, no roll and no save. Converted: every missile goes to the one foe chosen, passing to the next foe standing as it falls (the SRD lets the caster split them). Omitted: Shield, which Westernesse has not yet. Before, Orsino's 1d4 + floor(#level/3) at a count of distinct foes drawn at random. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: A drowsiness falls on the place you aim it at: of everyone there, friend or foe, the least first, it lays four Hit Dice of them asleep, and none of five or more; whoever shakes it off stays awake, and a blow wakes a sleeper.

source.notes: The SRD's Sleep (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 14): first level, a burst (the rules' areas: everyone in the place it falls on, friend or foe), four Hit Dice of them, fewest first, none of five or more (HitDicePool; a Kyr creature's Hit Dice are its level), a Will save to negate (the sleep save, made with Wisdom, which the undead are proof against), at case 7's difficulty for a first-level spell. A blow that wounds wakes the sleeper (the asleep condition's own). Converted: a minute, ten rounds, at every casting level (Kyr's durations do not grow with the caster: the SRD's is a minute a level); outside a fight, ten watches (FieldUse). Omitted: the sleeper helpless (a blow at one is an ordinary blow); the nearest first among equals (the fight's order). Before, Orsino's third level, every foe, three rounds, against 16 + the caster's level. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.description: A stroke of lightning leaps from your hand to the foe you aim it at, 1d6 for every level you have, to twenty, and from them to as many other foes as you have levels, each taking half what the first took; whoever throws themselves clear takes half.

source.notes: The SRD's Chain Lightning (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 15): sixth level, 1d6 electricity a casting level to 20d6 at the twentieth on the one it is aimed at, and a leap to one other foe a casting level, to twenty (the rules' chain: each struck once, in the fight's order, never a friend), each leap half what the first was dealt, rounded down; a Reflex save for half by each, at case 7's difficulty for a sixth-level spell. Adapted: the leaps go to foes in the fight's order (the SRD's caster chooses them, within 30 feet of the first). Orsino's had no effect Kyr could run (its cascade: unsupported). Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43). Its lightning sets off nothing by its kind (the SRD's harm lays nothing by its kind: triggers false, srd-proving-cases.md case 56).

cure_disease.name: Cure Disease
cure_disease.description: Lay a hand on yourself or one of the company and drive out every sickness in them: a fever, a rot, the dead's infection.

source.notes: The SRD's Remove Disease (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 42): third level, its school conjuration beside Life, on the caster or one ally (the creature touched), every disease on them ended (every condition whose harm is disease: the Diseased, the Infected), and nothing else; at once, in a fight or out of one. Its save is the SRD's harmless one. Kept: Orsino's name (the dens' Scroll of Cure Disease is named for it, though the scroll's own use ends the Diseased alone). Omitted: the parasites and green slime it kills; the diseases the SRD says it may not counter, which Kyr has none of. Before, Orsino's the same removal, without the SRD's school.

cure.name: Cure Light Wounds
cure.description: Bind light wounds: 1d8, and a point for every level you have, to five.

source.notes: The SRD's Cure Light Wounds (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 16): 1d8 and a point a casting level, to 5 (by #castingLevel), on one ally; its school the SRD's conjuration, beside its domain. Omitted: the harm a cure does the undead (the SRD's touch and its Will save for half), and spell resistance. Before, Orsino's 1d8, the same at every level.

cure_moderate.name: Cure Moderate Wounds
cure_moderate.description: Bind moderate wounds: 2d8, and a point for every level you have, to ten.

source.notes: The SRD's Cure Moderate Wounds (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 16): second level, 2d8 and a point a casting level, to 10 (by #castingLevel), on one ally; its school the SRD's conjuration, beside its domain. Omitted: the harm a cure does the undead (the SRD's touch and its Will save for half), and spell resistance. Before, Orsino's third level and 2d8, the same at every level.

cure_serious.name: Cure Serious Wounds
cure_serious.description: Bind serious wounds: 3d8, and a point for every level you have, to fifteen.

source.notes: The SRD's Cure Serious Wounds (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 16): third level, 3d8 and a point a casting level, to 15 (by #castingLevel), on one ally; its school the SRD's conjuration, beside its domain. Omitted: the harm a cure does the undead (the SRD's touch and its Will save for half), and spell resistance. Before, Orsino's fourth level and 3d8, the same at every level.

cure_critical.name: Cure Critical Wounds
cure_critical.description: Bind critical wounds: 4d8, and a point for every level you have, to twenty.

source.notes: The SRD's Cure Critical Wounds (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 16): fourth level, 4d8 and a point a casting level, to 20 (by #castingLevel), on one ally; its school the SRD's conjuration, beside its domain. Omitted: the harm a cure does the undead (the SRD's touch and its Will save for half), and spell resistance. Before, Orsino's sixth level and 4d8, the same at every level.

divine_favor.name: Divine Favor
divine_favor.description: Call on your god's favour: for a minute you strike truer and harder, by one, two from the sixth level, three from the ninth.

source.notes: The SRD's Divine Favor (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 23, by the owner's word of 18 November): on the caster, +1 to hit and +1 damage (Orsino's blessed, the SRD's +1 luck) for a minute, ten rounds; its school the SRD's evocation beside its domain. Kept: Orsino's level, a War cantrip, where the SRD's is first level (the lead's decision: at the first level 48 installed divine casters would lose it and none gain it); and a point more of each at the sixth casting level and the ninth, to +3 (the SRD's +1 each three casting levels; exact since case 60: an amount its caster throws, ConditionAmount). Before, Orsino's blessed and keen (+2 to hit and damage more, a telling blow on 18) for three rounds.

armor.name: Mage Armor
armor.description: An unseen armour of force about you or one beside you, as good as a mail coat.
armor.effect: Apply mage_armored to ally for 20 turns.

source.notes: The SRD's Mage Armor by its resolution (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 22, the owner's word of 18 November: option 2): the caster or one ally, a +4 armour bonus of force that does not add to worn armour, no temporary hit points. Kept: Orsino's school, abjuration, where the SRD's is conjuration (the school moves abjurers' and conjurers' draws). Converted: the fight, twenty rounds, where the SRD's is an hour a level. Before, Orsino's on the caster alone, four harder to hit over worn armour, and twenty temporary hit points.

blur.name: Blur
blur.description: The one you touch, yourself or a companion, blurs and wavers: one blow in five meant for them goes astray, for a minute for every level you have.

source.notes: The SRD's Blur (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 49): second level (Orsino's first), illusion, on the caster or one ally (the creature touched), concealment for a minute a casting level (Lasting): one blow in five that would land goes astray (concealed: the SRD's 20 % miss chance, thrown on d100 once a blow lands, exact since case 57; it had been Westernesse's evasion of 3, the same one in five). Omitted: the creatures that see through it (true seeing). Before, Orsino's first level, on the caster alone, three rounds of one harder to hit, +2 against magic and an evasion of 10.

barkskin.name: Barkskin
barkskin.description: The skin of the one you touch, yourself or a companion, thickens and toughens like bark: two harder to hit, and a point more for every three levels you have past the third, to five, for ten minutes for every level you have.

source.notes: The SRD's Barkskin (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 50): second level (the SRD's druid's; Orsino's first), its school transmutation beside Nature, on the caster or one ally (the creature touched), Orsino's barkskin (two harder to hit, added to worn armour: the SRD's natural armour +2) for ten minutes a casting level, a hundred rounds (Lasting). And a point more each three casting levels past the third, to +5 at the twelfth (exact since case 59: an amount its caster throws, ConditionAmount); it lasts the fight. Before, Orsino's first level, on the caster alone, three rounds.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Bless your company, yourself among them: each fights with a divine boon for a minute.

source.notes: The SRD's Bless (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 17): the caster and every ally, first level, its school the SRD's enchantment beside its domain. Converted: the whole company, where the SRD's is those within fifty feet (Kyr's field has no distances). A minute, ten rounds, a casting level (exact since case 46: Lasting). Kept: Orsino's blessed (+1 to hit and +1 damage; Divine Favor and Neptune's Blessing lay it too), where the SRD's is +1 to hit and to saves against fear. Before, Orsino's one ally for three rounds.

calm_emotions.name: Calm Emotions
calm_emotions.description: A calm falls on the place you aim it at: friend or foe, whoever does not shake it off stands quiet and does nothing, until a blow breaks it.
calm_emotions.effect: Apply calmed to enemies for 3 turns unless will save against (12 + floor((#castingScore - 10) / 2) + floor(#castingLevel / 2) + #bonusSpellDC).

source.notes: The SRD's Calm Emotions (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 24): second level, its school enchantment beside Nature, a burst (everyone in the place it falls on, friend or foe), a Will save to negate at case 7's difficulty for a second-level spell; whoever fails is calmed, doing nothing, until harm or a blow from another breaks it (the calmed condition). Converted: three rounds, the census's caster's (the third level), at every casting level, for the SRD's concentration up to a round a level (Kyr's casters do not concentrate); a calmed creature does nothing, where the SRD's may defend itself (Kyr's fight has no action between a blow and none). Omitted: a blow on one breaking it on all; the fear, confusion and morale it suppresses; the undead's and constructs' proof against the mind (its save is Will, as Hold Person's). Before, Orsino's calm on every foe, against 15 + the caster's level: a boon to them (immune to fear and madness, +1 to hit, +2 to Will saves). Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

remove_fear.name: Remove Fear
remove_fear.description: Steady a companion, or yourself: any fear on them lifts, and fear takes hold of them far less for ten minutes.

source.notes: The SRD's Remove Fear (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 21): first level, its school abjuration beside Life, on the caster or one ally: any fear on them ends, and for ten minutes (a hundred rounds) they have +4 against fear (the heartened condition). Converted: the fear on them ended, where the SRD's is suppressed for the spell's ten minutes (Kyr's fear lasts a few rounds); the ten minutes end with the fight, as every condition of a fight does; its save the SRD's harmless one. Omitted: the SRD's one more subject each four casting levels (Kyr aims a spell at one ally or the whole company). Before, Orsino's: the fear on one ally ended, and nothing after.

terror.name: Cause Fear
terror.description: Fill one foe of five Hit Dice or fewer with dread: afraid for a few rounds, or for one if they master it.

source.notes: The SRD's Cause Fear (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 20): first level, its school necromancy beside Death, one foe of five Hit Dice or fewer (a pool of five on one: HitDicePool), a save against fear (made with Wisdom, the SRD's Will) at case 7's difficulty for a first-level spell; whoever fails is afraid three rounds, whoever saves one (the save's lesser hold: the SRD's partial). Converted: three rounds for the SRD's 1d4 (its mean, 2.5, rounded up: Kyr's durations are not rolled). Kept: Orsino's fear (−2 to hit, −2 to every save, −1 to every roll, slower), the same for the failed and the saved, where the SRD's frightened flees and its shaken does not (Kyr's afraid do not flee; their penalties are near the shaken's). Omitted: the living only (Kyr's undead are not proof against fear). Before, Orsino's second level, any one foe, three rounds against 15 + the caster's level, or none for whoever saved. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

shield.name: Shield of Faith
shield.description: A shimmer of faith stands about you or a companion, turning blows aside: two harder to hit, and a point more for every six levels you have, to five, for a minute for every level.

source.notes: The SRD's Shield of Faith (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 19): first level, its school abjuration beside Law, on the caster or one ally (the creature touched), two harder to hit by a deflection that adds to worn armour (the shield_of_faith condition). And a point more each six casting levels, to +5 at the eighteenth (exact since case 59: an amount its caster throws, ConditionAmount). A minute, ten rounds, a casting level (exact since case 46: Lasting). Its save is the SRD's harmless one, made by none who takes it willingly. Before, Orsino's second level and its shielded (one harder to hit, ten more hit points and +1 against magic), which Orsino's abyssal shield keeps.

entangle.name: Tangling Vines
entangle.description: Grass, weeds and roots rise where you point and wrap whoever stands there, friend or foe: whoever does not spring clear is held fast, striking and dodging badly, for a minute.

source.notes: The SRD's Entangle (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 31): first level, its school transmutation beside Nature, a burst on friend and foe (the rules' areas made Orsino's one), each a Reflex save against case 7's difficulty for a first-level spell or entangled (Orsino's condition: two worse to hit, Dexterity five less, slower to act). A minute, ten rounds, a casting level (exact since case 46: Lasting). Omitted: the plants it needs (Kyr's field does not say what grows there), the vines trying again each round at whoever slipped them (a persistent area: proof-slices.md, do not cross yet), the half speed of whoever saved and the Strength or Escape Artist check to tear free (Kyr's fight has no movement). Before, Orsino's three rounds against 15 and the caster's whole level.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.description: Figments of you stand all about you for a minute, 1d4 of them and one more for every three levels you have; a blow or a touch meant for you may fall on one of them instead, and a figment struck is gone.

source.notes: The SRD's Mirror Image (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 40): second level, illusion, on the caster, 1d4 images and one each three casting levels to eight (by #castingLevel, thrown as it is cast); each attack roll at the caster falls on the caster or an image, each as likely, and one at an image is struck as though it wore nothing, a hit putting it out (Images). A minute, ten rounds, a casting level (exact since case 46: Lasting). Omitted: the images' moving within five feet; a foe that cannot see being fooled the less; the images' own size. Before, Orsino's two harder to hit, +2 to every save and an evasion of 15, for three rounds.

mass_curse.name: Bane
mass_curse.description: Fill your foes with dread for a minute: their blows go wider, and fear finds them easier; whoever stands firm against it is untouched.

source.notes: The SRD's Bane (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 39): first level (Orsino's third), its school enchantment beside Death, every foe, a Will save to negate (the fear save, made with Wisdom, which a ward against fear helps) at case 7's difficulty, baned: −1 to hit and −1 on saves against fear. Converted: every foe, where the SRD's is those within fifty feet (Kyr's field has no distances). A minute, ten rounds, a casting level (exact since case 46: Lasting). Omitted: the SRD's dispelling of Bless. Before, Orsino's Mass Curse, cursed (−1 to every score) for three rounds against 15 + the caster's level. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

resist_fire.name: Resist Fire
resist_fire.description: Lay a hand on yourself or one of the company, and fire's heat is held off them for the fight: ten less from every burn.
resist_fire.effect: Apply fire_resistant to ally for 20 turns.

source.notes: The SRD's Resist Energy, against fire (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 38): second level, its school abjuration beside Life, on the caster or one ally (the creature touched), fire-resistant: ten off each blow of fire (a flat resistance, the new resist modifier). Converted: ten at every casting level (the SRD's twenty from the seventh and thirty from the eleventh omitted: a condition's amount does not read its caster); the fight, twenty rounds, where the SRD's is ten minutes a level; fire alone, where the SRD's caster chooses the energy. Its save is the SRD's harmless one. Before, Orsino's fireproof (half of fire's harm) for three rounds.

protection_from_evil.name: Protection from Evil
protection_from_evil.description: A ward of faith stands about one of the company: blows turn aside from it, harm finds it steadier, and no voice can bend its will, for a minute.

source.notes: The SRD's Protection from Evil (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 32): first level, its school abjuration beside Law, on the caster or one ally (the creature touched), warded (the warded_from_evil condition): two harder to hit by a deflection that adds to worn armour, +2 to every save, and proof against charm (the SRD's mental control). A minute, ten rounds, a casting level (exact since case 46: Lasting). Adapted: against every foe, where the SRD's is against the evil (Kyr's fight does not ask a foe's alignment). Omitted: the summoned creatures' touch it keeps off. Its save is the SRD's harmless one, made by none who takes it willingly. Before, Orsino's protected and courage for three rounds: proof against charm and fear, half of necrotic harm, +2 to saves, and no ward against blows.

command.name: Command
command.description: One word, spoken with the god's authority: Fall! Whoever does not shake it off throws themselves down and loses their turn.
command.effect: Apply prone to enemy for 1 turn unless will save against (11 + floor((#castingScore - 10) / 2) + floor(#castingLevel / 2) + #bonusSpellDC).

source.notes: The SRD's Command (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 33): first level (Orsino's fifth), its school enchantment beside Law, one foe, a Will save to negate at case 7's difficulty for a first-level spell, and one round: the SRD's 'Fall', whoever fails prone (the prone condition: they lose their turn, Dexterity two less). Adapted: the one command of the SRD's five that Kyr's fight can hold (approach, drop, flee and halt want movement, things in hand, or a flight that is not leaving the fight). Omitted: its language and the mindless's proof (its save is Will, as Hold Person's). Before, Orsino's fifth level, a Will save against 20, and two rounds fleeing: the foe gone from the fight. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

hold_animal.name: Hold Animal
hold_animal.description: Hold a beast where it stands, unable to move or act, a turn for each level you have; each turn it may tear free of it.

source.notes: The SRD's Hold Animal (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 48), Hold Person's for an animal: one animal (a body of the animal kind: Targeting.bears), second level (the SRD's druid's; Orsino's a cantrip), its school enchantment beside Law (Kyr's casts it as a cleric of Law), a Will save to negate at case 7's difficulty, and a new save on each turn the held one loses to it, a success ending it (ShakingOff), for a round a casting level (Lasting). Spell resistance answers it. Omitted: the held helpless. Before, Orsino's cantrip, three rounds against 15 + the caster's level saved with Strength, which fell on no Kyr animal (none bore the animal trait it wanted).

hold_person.name: Hold Person
hold_person.description: Hold a person where they stand, unable to move or act; each turn the held one may tear free of it.

source.notes: The SRD's Hold Person (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 18): one humanoid, second level, its school enchantment beside Law, a Will save to negate at case 7's difficulty, and a new save on each turn the held one loses to it, a success ending it (ShakingOff). Converted: five rounds, a fifth-level caster's, at every casting level (the SRD's is a round a level). Omitted: the held helpless. Before, Orsino's three rounds against 20 + the caster's level, saved with Strength, once. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

paralyzing_touch.name: Paralyzing Touch
paralyzing_touch.description: Your touch stiffens a living person where they stand, unable to move or act, for a little while; a hardy one shakes it off at once. Their armour does not turn your hand aside, only their quickness.

source.notes: The SRD's Ghoul Touch (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 36): second level, necromancy, one humanoid a melee touch attack lands on (Touch), paralysed unless a Fortitude save at case 7's difficulty for a second-level spell negates it. Converted: six rounds, the SRD's 1d6+2, its mean rounded up (Kyr's durations are not rolled). Omitted: the stench that sickens those beside the paralysed; the undead's and elves' proof against it beyond the humanoid it wants. Before, Orsino's three rounds on one humanoid against 14 + the caster's level, saved with Strength, no attack roll. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

cone_of_cold.name: Cone of Cold
cone_of_cold.description: Cold bursts from your hands in a cone, 1d6 for every level you have, to fifteen, on everyone it catches, friend or foe; whoever throws themselves clear takes half.

source.notes: The SRD's Cone of Cold (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 7): fifth level, 1d6 cold a casting level to 15d6 at the fifteenth (by #castingLevel), a cone (the rules' areas: every place from the caster out to where it is aimed, friend or foe), a Reflex save for half. Converted: the save's difficulty is the SRD's 10 + the spell's level + the casting score's modifier, and half the casting level, since a Westernesse save adds the saver's whole level where the SRD's base save adds about half of it (18 for a ninth-level caster of 16 is 22). Before, Orsino's 3d12 on 1d6 + half the level foes drawn at random, a magic save against 15. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43). Its cold sets off none of Orsino's freezing (the SRD's harm lays nothing by its kind: triggers false, srd-proving-cases.md case 56).

lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning_bolt.description: A stroke of lightning runs from your hand in a line, 1d6 for every level you have, to ten, through the one you aim it at and the first in its way before and beyond, friend or foe; whoever throws themselves clear takes half.

source.notes: The SRD's Lightning Bolt (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 9): 1d6 electricity a casting level to 10d6 at the tenth (by #castingLevel), a line (the rules' areas: the one aimed at, and the first standing in each place the line crosses from the caster out to the far end, friend or foe), a Reflex save for half at the SRD's difficulty for a third-level spell and half the casting level (case 7's conversion). Its level the SRD's third since case 12 (Orsino's had been the fourth). Omitted: the SRD's bolt setting things alight and breaking through barriers. Before, Orsino's 3d8 on two foes drawn at random, a magic save against 15, and paralysis on a second save, which the SRD's has not. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43). Its lightning sets off nothing by its kind (the SRD's harm lays nothing by its kind: triggers false, srd-proving-cases.md case 56).

burning_hands.name: Burning Hands
burning_hands.description: A fan of flame leaps from your fingertips, 1d4 for every level you have, to five, on everyone between you and where you aim it, friend or foe; whoever throws themselves clear takes half.

source.notes: The SRD's Burning Hands (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 12): first level, 1d4 fire a casting level to 5d4 at the fifth (by #castingLevel), a cone (the rules' areas), a Reflex save for half at the SRD's difficulty and half the casting level (case 7's conversion). Omitted: setting things alight. Before, Orsino's second level and 2d6 on every foe, no save. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43).

acid_splash.name: Acid Splash
acid_splash.description: A small orb of acid flies at one foe, dealing 1d3 acid if it strikes.

source.notes: The SRD's Acid Splash: a conjuration cantrip, one foe by ranged touch, 1d3 acid and no spell resistance. Its acid sets off none of Orsino's acid burn. Omitted: its close range; cantrips use Kyr's unlimited casting.

disrupt_undead.name: Disrupt Undead
disrupt_undead.description: A ray of positive energy strikes one undead foe for 1d6 if it lands.

source.notes: The SRD's Disrupt Undead: a necromancy cantrip, one undead foe by ranged touch, 1d6 untyped damage and spell resistance. Omitted: close range and a distinct positive-energy damage tag. Kyr cantrips are cast at will and its general damage reduction can affect nonphysical damage.

acid_arrow.name: Acid Arrow
acid_arrow.description: An arrow of acid flies from your hand at one foe: 2d4 if the shot lands, and the acid clings and burns 2d4 more at the end of each of its turns, a turn for every three levels you have.

source.notes: The SRD's Acid Arrow (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 44): second level (Orsino's first), conjuration, one foe a ranged touch attack lands on (Touch), 2d4 acid, and the acid clinging (acid_clinging: 2d4 acid at the end of its holder's turn) for a round every three casting levels, to six at the eighteenth (Lasting: none at the first and second). No spell resistance (the SRD's). Its acid sets off none of Orsino's acid burn (triggers: false), which the SRD's has not. Omitted: the arrow's range. Before, Orsino's sure 1d4 acid on one foe at the first level, and its acid burn.

ray_of_frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray_of_frost.description: A ray of freezing air and ice springs from your finger at one foe: 1d3 cold if it strikes.

source.notes: The SRD's Ray of Frost (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 45): a cantrip (Orsino's second level), evocation, one foe a ranged touch attack lands on (Touch), 1d3 cold; spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance). Its cold sets off none of Orsino's freezing (triggers: false), which the SRD's has not. Omitted: its range. Before, Orsino's sure 2d6 cold on one foe at the second level.

life_drain.name: Vampiric Touch
life_drain.description: Your touch draws the life out of a foe, 1d6 for every two levels you have, to ten, and what you draw mends you.

source.notes: The SRD's Vampiric Touch (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 52), Orsino's Life Drain: third level (the SRD's wizard's; Orsino's second), necromancy beside Death (Kyr's casts it as a cleric of Death, and the dead as their own), one foe a melee touch lands on (Touch), 1d6 negative energy (Kyr's necrotic) every two casting levels to 10d6, no save, spell resistance answering it; its harm sets off none of Orsino's necrotic disease (triggers: false). Converted: what it draws mends its caster (Kyr's drain), where the SRD's gives as many temporary hit points for an hour. Before, Orsino's 1d6 necrotic at every level, no touch, negated by a magic save against 15.

shocking_grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking_grasp.description: Your hand crackles with lightning, 1d6 for every level you have, to five, on the one you touch: their armour does not turn your hand aside, only their quickness.

source.notes: The SRD's Shocking Grasp (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 35): first level (Orsino's second), 1d6 electricity a casting level to 5d6 at the fifth (by #castingLevel), on one foe a melee touch attack lands on (Touch: worn armour, hide and an armour of force do not count). Omitted: the +3 against a foe in metal armour; a touch's critical (Kyr's criticals are a weapon's weight); holding the charge. Its harm is Kyr's electric, as Lightning Bolt's: Orsino's lightning may paralyse, which the SRD's has not. Before, Orsino's 2d6 lightning on one foe, no attack roll. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43). Its lightning sets off nothing by its kind (the SRD's harm lays nothing by its kind: triggers false, srd-proving-cases.md case 56).

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: A bead of fire flies to where you aim it and bursts, 1d6 for every level you have, to ten, on everyone in the place it bursts in, friend or foe; whoever throws themselves clear takes half.

source.notes: The SRD's Fireball (doc/architecture/mission-22/srd-proving-cases.md, case 12): third level, 1d6 fire a casting level to 10d6 at the tenth (by #castingLevel), a burst (the rules' areas: everyone in the place it bursts in), a Reflex save for half at the SRD's difficulty and half the casting level (case 7's conversion). Omitted: the bead's range and setting things alight. Before, Orsino's fourth level and 6d6, a magic save against 15. Spell resistance answers it (SpellResistance, srd-proving-cases.md case 43). Its fire sets off none of Orsino's burning (the SRD's harm lays nothing by its kind: triggers false, srd-proving-cases.md case 56).

conjure_light.name: Light
conjure_light.description: A small steady light that hangs over a companion's shoulder for two hours.
conjure_light.effect: Apply lit to ally for 2 hours.

source.notes: The old-school Light spell, which Orsino's catalog lacks; every mage learns it as an apprentice.

knock.name: Knock
knock.description: A lock or bar the caster points at opens of itself.

source.notes: The old-school Knock, which Orsino's catalog lacks, as the SRD's (one door, box or chest; instantaneous): a verb tried on what it is cast at, which the kernel's opening rule answers by the lockwork change already written of it (data/rules/probing.kyr; the owner, 26 November: "this door opens" is a verb). It had laid unbarring, lockwork for an hour.

comprehend_languages.name: Comprehend Languages
comprehend_languages.description: For an hour, old letters and strange tongues read as plainly as one's own.
comprehend_languages.effect: Apply lettered to ally for 1 hour.

source.notes: The SRD's Comprehend Languages (Brd 1, Clr 1, Sor/Wiz 1), which Orsino's catalog lacks: whoever bears it reads what lore reads for an hour (the SRD's ten minutes a level, at the level Kyr's casters go below at). Laid on a companion, not only the caster, so that it is cast between fights as a ward is.

pratfall.name: Pratfall
pratfall.description: Go down on purpose as the blow comes, the way a clown goes down a flight of stairs: it lands on nothing, and you are up again behind it.
pratfall.effect: Apply dodge to self for 2 turns.

source.notes: The first foundation of the Gentle Art (Wapshott's Circus): a fall chosen, not suffered. Orsino's dodge status, for one exchange, on a longer recharge than Dodge itself.

feint.name: Feint
feint.description: Show the eye one thing and the hand another: the shoulder that says left while the hip goes right. A foe who follows it strikes at where you are not.
feint.effect: Apply distracted to enemy for 2 turns unless wisdom save against (12).

source.notes: The third foundation of the Gentle Art (Wapshott's Circus): the fencing-master's feint taught with a broom handle. Orsino's distracted status, as a technique rather than the arcane Minor Distraction.

echo.name: Echo
echo.description: Give a foe back its own voice and bearing, a beat late, until it cannot tell which of you it is answering: the second degree of the Gentle Art.
echo.effect: Apply distracted to enemies for 1 turn unless wisdom save against (13).

source.notes: Mother Pell's art of voices (Wapshott's Circus, Phase II): imitation as attention, not mimicry of powers. Orsino's distracted status on every foe for one exchange; nothing of a foe's abilities is copied.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.description: Give a foe's own weight back to it, as the mirror-door of Pell and Fell gives back a movement: its rush carries it over its own feet.
reversal.effect: Deal (1d8) physical damage to enemy unless dexterity save against (13).

source.notes: Taught by Mumchance and Mother Pell together (Wapshott's Circus, Phase II): the door to the Mirror, and not the Mirror. Damage by the foe's own momentum, which a quick foe avoids.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: Stand in front of a companion: until your next turn, blows aimed at them strike you.
guard.effect: Apply guarded to ally for 2 turns.

source.notes: A warrior's interception, in place of positions or reach.

maul.name: Maul
maul.description: Make a powerful attack that deals 1d6 + strength modifier extra damage and inflicts bleeding on a successful hit.
maul.windup: rears up on its hind legs

source.notes: Orsino's Maul without its slow (which Kyr cannot execute), given to bears as a blow they gather for a turn first: stun the bear in between and it is lost.

detonation.name: Detonation
detonation.description: A fiery explosion: fire over everyone it is set against, and nothing left of it.

source.notes: Orsino's 2d6 fire on the enemies, then the charge gone; its damage to the enemies is the shape Arrow Volley plays, which the generated record had not.

breathe_disintegration.name: Disintegrating breath
breathe_disintegration.description: A breath that unmakes what it touches pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves it. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A dragon lineage's breath weapon, of the shape every breath has: all its foes, a save vs breath for half, three turns to breathe again. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_thunder.name: Deafening breath
breathe_thunder.description: A roar of breath pours over everyone before the creature and deafens those who do not save; a breath save halves it. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A dragon lineage's breath weapon, of the shape every breath has: all its foes, a save vs breath for half, three turns to breathe again. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_blinding.name: Blinding breath
breathe_blinding.description: A glare of breath pours over everyone before the creature and blinds those who do not save; a breath save halves it. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A dragon lineage's breath weapon, of the shape every breath has: all its foes, a save vs breath for half, three turns to breathe again. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_holy.name: Holy breath
breathe_holy.description: A breath of searing light pours over everyone before the creature; a breath save halves it. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A dragon lineage's breath weapon, of the shape every breath has: all its foes, a save vs breath for half, three turns to breathe again. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

breathe_madness.name: Maddening breath
breathe_madness.description: A breath that turns the mind pours over everyone before the creature and confuses those who do not save; a breath save halves it. Recharges in three turns, and comes at most three times a day.

source.notes: A dragon lineage's breath weapon, of the shape every breath has: all its foes, a save vs breath for half, three turns to breathe again. A cone: it catches whoever stands between the creature and where it is aimed, friend or foe (see Positions); three times a day, as the old games' dragons breathe (Kyr's own: Orsino's breath is a weapon, unlimited).

energy_drain.name: Energy drain
energy_drain.description: A cold touch that takes a level of the one it lands on: their strength in a fight, their spells and their health, until a restoration gives it back.

source.notes: Kyr's own, the old games' energy drain (the wight's and the wraith's touch: a level for each that lands, no save); Orsino's undead drain no levels. Rests three turns, as Orsino's skills that name none.

greater_energy_drain.name: Greater energy drain
greater_energy_drain.description: A touch that takes two levels of the one it lands on, until a restoration gives them back.

source.notes: Kyr's own, the old games' vampire's and spectre's drain of two levels a touch; Orsino's undead drain no levels.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.description: A prayer that gives back to one who was drained what the dead took: every level lost.

source.notes: Kyr's own, the old games' restoration, the one remedy for energy drain (a temple's service, or a cleric's spell). It lifts every level taken at once, where the old games give back one a casting.

hornet_swarm.name: Hornet Swarm
hornet_swarm.description: A prayer to the wild that is answered out of the nearest hollow tree: a brown cloud of hornets over every foe, stinging, so that they strike wild while it lasts.
hornet_swarm.effect: Deal (1d4) piercing damage to enemies. Apply distracted to enemies for 2 turns unless reflex save against (15 + #level + #bonusSpellDC).

source.notes: Demonstration content (Mission 19, journey 5, 7 November): a spell added by its record alone, for clerics of nature, and cast in a fight in a generated country.

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.description: Heal for a small amount of health.

source.notes: Orsino adds the caster's whole wisdom score; Kyr scores run 3 to 18 against a first-level company's 6 to 16 hit points, so the score's modifier is added instead: an at-will Kindle had healed 1d3+10 (rounds 10 and 11, R and T; R10-12, R11-05).

rejuvenate.name: Rejuvenate
rejuvenate.description: Heal a small amount of health for an ally.

source.notes: Orsino adds the caster's whole wisdom score; Kyr scores run 3 to 18 against a first-level company's 6 to 16 hit points, so the score's modifier is added instead: an at-will Kindle had healed 1d3+10 (rounds 10 and 11, R and T; R10-12, R11-05).

greater_rejuvenate.name: Greater Rejuvenate
greater_rejuvenate.description: Heal a large amount of health.

source.notes: Orsino adds the caster's whole wisdom score; Kyr scores run 3 to 18 against a first-level company's 6 to 16 hit points, so the score's modifier is added instead: an at-will Kindle had healed 1d3+10 (rounds 10 and 11, R and T; R10-12, R11-05).

mass_rejuvenate.name: Mass Rejuvenate
mass_rejuvenate.description: Heal a massive amount of health for all allies.

source.notes: Orsino adds the caster's whole wisdom score; Kyr scores run 3 to 18 against a first-level company's 6 to 16 hit points, so the score's modifier is added instead: an at-will Kindle had healed 1d3+10 (rounds 10 and 11, R and T; R10-12, R11-05).

holy.name: Holy
holy.description: Smite your foes with holy energy.
holy.effect: Deal (3d6 + statMod(#wisdom)) radiant damage to enemies. Apply deafened to enemies for 3 turns unless fortitude save against (18 + #level + #bonusSpellDC).

source.notes: Orsino adds the caster's whole wisdom score; Kyr scores run 3 to 18 against a first-level company's 6 to 16 hit points, so the score's modifier is added instead: an at-will Kindle had healed 1d3+10 (rounds 10 and 11, R and T; R10-12, R11-05).
